question: Should ClawSweeper adopt the proposed seven-day cross-route ingress identity protocol, with rollout deferred until https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674 has landed and an isolated paired-delivery canary succeeds?
rationale: The retained identity fields, receipt lifetime, downstream dispatcher contract, and rollout sequencing define a durable automation protocol; they cannot be selected safely by mechanical patch review alone.

options.title: Defer and validate after the dependency
options.body: Keep this as a draft, rebase after https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674, and require the stated isolated canary to prove both routes and all revision cases before merge.

options.title: Approve the protocol direction now
options.body: Approve the v1 field set and retention policy now, while still treating the subsequent rebase and live canary as merge gates.

recommendation.title: Defer and validate after the dependency
recommendation.body: Keep this as a draft, rebase after https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674, and require the stated isolated canary to prove both routes and all revision cases before merge.
